menu.title: Menu
login.title: Welcome!

login.privacyNote: We only store your email address and your characters. Nothing else.

login.checkIntro: We sent a password to {email}. It is four words and a number. Type it in here.

login.noMailHelp: Look in your spam folder. It can take a minute.
login.resent: A new mail is on its way.
login.wrongPassword: The password does not match. Check the four words and the number.
login.passwordMissing: Type in the password from the mail.

login.mailNotConfigured: This builder cannot send mails right now. Please tell the person who runs it.

flow.choseForMe: Done. You can see the choice below and change it.

level.changeAfter: They are remembered in case you take {levelName} {old} again.

pick.noOptions: There is nothing to choose here right now.

change.textGeneric: If you change this, these choices no longer fit:

change.afterGeneric: You will need to choose them again. If you change it back later, they will be there again.
overview.question: Is everything the way you want it?
overview.intro: Here you see everything at a glance. You can still change every step.
overview.finishBlocked: This works once nothing is open any more.

done.pdfNotYet: Printing comes with the next version. Your character is saved and stays saved.

done.tipSheetOnly: Print on A4 at actual size (100 %).

origins.title: What you get without choosing
origins.intro: These things are on your sheet because they come with something you chose.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies right away to all texts. Your character stays the same.
settings.unitsHint: Applies right away, everywhere: on screen, on the sheet and on the cards.
settings.saveError: That did not work. Please try again.
settings.passwordText: We will send you a new password. The old one then stops working.
settings.passwordConfirmText: The old password then stops working. You will be logged out on other devices.
settings.passwordSent: A new password is on its way.
settings.logoutText: You can log in again with your email address at any time.
settings.privacyText: Your email address, your password as a check value, your settings and your characters. Nothing else.
settings.deleteText: Deletes your email address, your settings and all your characters.
settings.deleteDialogText: We will delete your email address, your settings and all your characters ({count}). This cannot be undone.
goodbye.title: Your account has been deleted.
goodbye.text: We deleted everything: your email address, your settings and your characters.
privacy.title: What we store
privacy.intro: We only store what the builder needs to work.
privacy.email: Your email address. We use it to send you your password.
privacy.password: Your password, only as a check value. Nobody can work out the password from it.
privacy.cookies: One cookie so you stay logged in. And one that remembers your language before you log in.
privacy.noTracking: No tracking, no ads, no statistics about you.
privacy.noThirdParty: Your browser loads nothing from other sites. No outside fonts, no outside scripts.
privacy.delete: You can delete your account in the settings at any time. Then everything is gone.
